Introduction

NexusERP RESTful multi-tenant ERP API for trading, retail, and wholesale.

Base URL: http://demo.nexuserp.test 
Welcome to the NexusERP API documentation.

NexusERP is a multi-tenant ERP platform designed for commercial, trading, wholesale, and inventory operations.

### Architecture & Core Conventions
- **Tenant Isolation**: Every tenant has an isolated PostgreSQL database. Requests must target the tenant subdomain (e.g. `http://alpha.nexuserp.test/api/v1/...`).
- **Standard Envelope**: All API responses use the standard JSON envelope:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "message": "Resource retrieved successfully.",
    "data": {},
    "meta": {}
  }
  ```
- **Monetary Precision**: All currency amounts are represented strictly in integer minor units (`*_cents` as 64-bit BIGINT, e.g. `$100.50` = `10050`). No floats are used.
- **Sequential Document Numbers**: Documents (Invoices, Bills, Receipts, Journals) use legal gap-free per-tenant numbering (`PREFIX-YYYY-000000`).

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Requests require an authenticated tenant session cookie or a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Tenant requests must target the tenant subdomain (e.g. http://{tenant}.nexuserp.test).

Endpoints

GET api/v1/accounting/accounts

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://demo.nexuserp.test/api/v1/accounting/accounts" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://demo.nexuserp.test/api/v1/accounting/accounts"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

POST api/v1/accounting/accounts

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://demo.nexuserp.test/api/v1/accounting/accounts" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"code\": \"b\",
    \"name\": \"n\",
    \"type\": \"liability\",
    \"parent_id\": \"architecto\",
    \"is_active\": false,
    \"currency\": \"ngz\",
    \"description\": \"Velit et fugiat sunt nihil accusantium.\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://demo.nexuserp.test/api/v1/accounting/accounts"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "code": "b",
    "name": "n",
    "type": "liability",
    "parent_id": "architecto",
    "is_active": false,
    "currency": "ngz",
    "description": "Velit et fugiat sunt nihil accusantium."
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

POST api/v1/accounting/accounts

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Example: application/json

Body Parameters

code   string     

Must not be greater than 32 characters. Example: b

name   string     

Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: n

type   string     

Example: liability

Must be one of:
  • asset
  • liability
  • equity
  • income
  • expense
parent_id   string  optional    

Must match an existing stored value. Example: architecto

is_active   boolean  optional    

Example: false

currency   string  optional    

Must be 3 characters. Example: ngz

description   string  optional    

Must not be greater than 1000 characters. Example: Velit et fugiat sunt nihil accusantium.

    --data "{
    \"code\": \"b\",
    \"name\": \"n\",

}"

);

This field is required when allocations is present. Example: architecto

Example: true
